setting.meaning: Missing settings are unmanaged. Empty state requires an empty value. Default requests target default resolution and requires an empty value. Explicit preserves the exact value, including an empty optional setting.

ptah.run/clickhouse/table.constraint: An explicit engine cannot be blank. Null properties are invalid. Conversion to an observation requires every setting to be explicit.
Engine cannot be blank. All properties must be present strings; an empty optional string records inspected absence. Incomplete inspection belongs in coverage.

canonicalization: Omitted and empty unspecified settings are equivalent. Strings must be valid UTF-8. Preserve all SQL expression text, ordering, and explicit empty values. Do not resolve defaults or equate SQL expressions.
